alt: A tiny mouse bites through a rope net to free a gentle lion in the forest.
A dog holding a bone looks at his reflection in the river from a bridge.
A fox watches cheese fall from the open beak of a crow in a tree.
An elderly farmer teaches his four sons with a bundle of sticks.
Monkeys copy a cap seller by dropping their colorful caps from a tree.
A monkey sits safely in a jamun tree while a crocodile waits in the river.
A shepherd boy calls toward the village while a wolf approaches the pasture.
An ant gathers grain while a grasshopper sings in a sunny meadow.
A water deity presents gold, silver, and iron axes to an honest woodcutter.
Two stubborn goats block each other's path on a narrow bridge.
Two goats cooperate to pass each other on a narrow bridge.
A farmer admires a hen and a golden egg in a village courtyard.
An elephant sprays muddy water toward clothes outside a tailor's shop.
A thirsty pigeon mistakes a painting of water on a wall for real water.
A fox looks up at grapes hanging high out of reach on a vine.
A flock of birds works together to carry a net into the sky.
A hare leads a lion to a stone well where the lion sees his reflection.
A little chick smiles with its mother beside a tiny cozy house.
A donkey carries sacks of wet cotton in a shallow river while its owner watches.
Two mice compare peaceful village food with a city feast watched by a cat.
